title: Write the missing provenance line, or recommend dropping the asset
ask: One shipped sound file has no line in CREDITS.md, which breaks that file's own opening rule that every entry must have verified terms before the first public build ships. Find where it came from, write its ledger line — source, terms, cost — and if its provenance cannot be established, say so plainly and recommend dropping it rather than shipping an asset whose rights are unknown.
first_action: Run the orphan check on assets/audio/sfx against CREDITS.md, then trace the file through git history to whoever added it.
source_message: One shipped sound file has no line in CREDITS.md, which breaks that file's own opening rule that every entry must have verified terms before the first public build ships. Find where it came from, write its ledger line — source, terms, cost — and if its provenance cannot be established, say so plainly and recommend dropping it rather than shipping an asset whose rights are unknown.
result: Done in this session. assets/audio/sfx/nope.wav is our own sound: synthesized by tools/gen_sfx.py, added 2026-08-27 in the same commit as the refusal feedback it voices (7707b3a), reproducible byte-for-byte by rerunning the generator. Its CREDITS.md entry is written; no third-party rights exist and nothing needs dropping. The ledger's stale paragraph describing the deleted water_cc0 candidates was corrected in the same edit.
